title: Paper execution audit: degrades honestly when the close is missing
headline_insight: 83 paper bets were logged, all executed=False, and realized CLV is unmeasurable for every settled row -- the ledger records 'no close captured' rather than fabricating a number.
what_it_means: This is a paper-only execution ledger: 83 logged bets, none of them real fills, and 37 settled by final score. Realized closing-line value is null for all 37 because no independent closing-price feed was wired for this channel, so the corpus honestly records the gap instead of backfilling a figure.
how_to_read: The one quantity this ledger can actually speak to is placement-time divergence between the model's number and the price taken, whose median is 0.09204799999999999 probability points -- a pre-trade sizing input, not realized edge.
why_it_matters: It shows the execution track exists and fails safe: when the close cannot be measured, it reports INSUFFICIENT_DATA rather than inventing a better-than-close result.
caveat: clv_pct is null for all 37 settled rows because no independent closing feed was captured, so no better-than-close (CLV) claim is possible from this corpus.
